generated.details: The palm-sized solid-color ivory puzzle cube has aligned rotating square segments separated by fine seams and rests mid-plane right on the desk beside the laptop.
The upper-right far-plane display shelving has two dark wood shelves secured to slim metal wall brackets, with recessed diffused lighting beneath them.
One small abstract metal object rests on the lower shelf, its folded brushed-aluminum ribbon joined to a stable flat foot.
A concealed RGB strip sits in a recessed channel behind the shelving, producing a restrained local magenta halo without product spill.
The upper-left far-plane wall art is an original cream, charcoal and muted-pink geometric painting on stretched canvas within a thin frame.
